Title: Quark Pancakes
Ingredients:
1. 1 cup quark (soft white cheese) 5%
2. 2 eggs
3. ½ cup all-purpose flour
4. 2 tbsp silan (date syrup)
5. 1 cup heavy cream
6. 4 petit beurre biscuits
Steps:
1. Mix the quark (soft white cheese) with the eggs and the all-purpose flour into a thick batter.
2. Fry spoonfuls of the batter in a greased skillet until golden on both sides.
3. Whip the heavy cream into whipped cream.
4. Serve with the whipped cream, crushed petit beurre biscuits and silan (date syrup).
